How it works

  1. 1
    Upload your slides

    PowerPoint, PDF or Word. Every slide is included, and you can leave any out.

  2. 2
    Read your notes

    Each topic gets a heading, key terms are picked out in bold, and reference lists are left out so it's just the content.

  3. 3
    Take them anywhere

    Show the pictures from your slides if you want them, search across all your notes, or export to PDF or Word.

Then test yourself

The same slides give you practice questions and flashcards, so you can go from reading to testing yourself in one place.

Questions

Is SlideQuiz free?

Yes. You can upload, make notes, practise questions and use flashcards for free.

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

No. Your files are read on your own device and never sent to us. If you make an account, the text of your notes and your progress are saved to it so you can use them on other devices. Your original files and slide pictures stay on your device.

Do I need an account?

No. Everything works without one. An account just lets you pick up your work on another device.

What files can I use?

PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF, Word (.docx) and plain text. You can also paste notes straight in. Scanned pages and photos of slides can't be read yet, because there's no text in them to use.

Does it work on my phone?

Yes. It works in any modern browser, and you can add it to your home screen so it opens like an app, even offline.
